title: PCFL-Active-Stream text-first action-conditioned lifetime paper target
summary: Replace the fixed-source PCFL-Stream target with a text-first on-policy lifetime proposal. A 0.75L pre-native NEW/reference cohort precedes three post-native NEW/OLD/CROSS checkpoints. Every target, including A4, succeeds only by a presealed legal world action and terminal return, independent of memory representation. Every twin side/checkpoint runs exact AUTH/TWIN/NULL clones; assigned memory controls one probe, is unmounted, and failure-inclusive cumulative action--evidence--delta--later-action links plus same-event/common-history controls test a narrow offline-compilation mechanism under one fixed online budget and assignment-independent paired compiler draws. Before B0, A2 must hash-bind unique lineage-local SELF instance/equivalence/addition semantics, presealed scheduling slots, the complete finite minimal unpadded agent-visible packet catalog and short statuses, L_native divisibility, latest-possible-support OLD embargo, physical unpadded-stream-first AS-CTX, filler stop, exact Dream/snapshot/checkpoint ties, and checkpoint lifecycle/readability/cursor/exhaustion/shape policy with blindness goldens. Fixed envelope age governs cadence only; claim-facing age is realized PAYLOAD_AGE/L_native. This protocol terminates scientifically at labeled eight-root B3 DEV/falsification with 908 rows/root; Stage C and population C1--C4 claims are DEFERRED_NEW_PREREGISTRATION with no current rejection, power, confirmation roster, or resource authority. A canonical one-to-one claim namespace preserves this deferred status, keeps A4 efficacy and Stage D non-applicable, and preserves associative LoRA only as a separately deferred conceptual successor after sealed text gates.
system_thesis: A continual experiential-memory system matters only if remembered life-specific structure changes an information-seeking action, that action changes public evidence, the evidence is reconsolidated without treatment or target leakage, and the resulting memory improves later unseen action while new knowledge is acquired and old knowledge retained after native context is exceeded. The current target is finite-range and synthetic. Associative LoRA is a separately deferred successor organ, not the source of dreaming, truth, planning, compression, or policy learning, and cannot rescue failed text organs.

Prospective/revision sleep runs only at the Stage-A2 opportunity-block/event-slot triggers and never receives envelope padding/header bytes. The reducer assigns every proposal/revision/addition/failure a unique lineage-local instance, never merges lifecycle by semantic equivalence, and admits disagreements without correctness selection. Checkpoint snapshots expose the frozen active/readable view through a deterministic pre-output cursor and fixed-shape exhaustion; sterile evaluations never re-enter.
loops.trigger: Only the pre-enumerated ORDINARY_SLEEP_CADENCE_V1 opportunity-block/event-slot IDs may trigger Dream-1, Dream-2, snapshot sealing, or an envelope-age q*L_native checkpoint. L_native is divisible by four. The complete finite reachable legal packet catalog, exact short status payloads, latest-possible-support OLD embargo, and physical unpadded-stream-first AS-CTX suffix are frozen. Target, truth, realized content or length, result, model output, contradiction, failure, latency, resource, and DEV-dependent triggers are forbidden. At a cutoff, final slot, Dream-2, snapshot, evaluation bind, and next Dream-1 follow the exact frozen tie order. Only realized PAYLOAD_AGE/L_native labels claim-facing x axes.

acceptance_tests.setup: Freeze this specification before implementation; after producer code exists, execute total target-independent opportunity/target allocation, causal twins, the presealed opportunity-block/event-slot schedule and tokenizer-exact constant-shape scheduling renderer, the six-target 0.75L pre-native NEW/reference cohort with no OLD/CROSS, six-per-cohort post-native NEW/OLD/CROSS rows, exact three-clone manifests, unique mapping growth, A4, and all failure denominators. Require L_native divisible by four; completely enumerate the finite reachable legal action/outcome/no-action/failure/overflow packet set; freeze the minimal canonical agent-visible payload and short fixed statuses; certify payload extrema and realized ages; preassign each OLD target against its latest possible support opportunity with later-support embargo and worst-case minimum unpadded distance >L_native; apply the exact envelope cutoff/tie rule; physically concatenate/retokenize unpadded payloads before taking the target-independent AS-CTX L_native suffix; and run filler/information-density checks.
acceptance_tests.expected: All allocations and fixed scheduling envelopes exist before actions, outcomes, or compilation; realized content and length cannot move a sleep/snapshot/checkpoint boundary; every block-close checkpoint equals its exact integer envelope-age q*L_native offset with no bisected slot or tolerance. Separately, maximum payload age at 0.75L is below L_native, minimum payload age at every post-native checkpoint is above L_native, every OLD row's presealed worst-case and realized unpadded age is strictly above L_native, later support is impossible, acquisition failures remain zero without relabeling, agent-visible payload equals PUBLIC_PAYLOAD_STREAM, unique causal information grows, and neutral envelope bytes never enter cognition or evict AS-CTX evidence. Figures use realized PAYLOAD_AGE/L_native, never envelope q, as the claim-facing x-axis.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The lifetime axis is filler or verbose status laundering, reachable packets are not finitely enumerable, support is treatment-selected, later re-support is possible, failed acquisition relabels OLD, payload bytes differ from agent-visible bytes, targets leak, pre-native age is impossible, padding manufactures context overflow or AS-CTX loss, L_native is not divisible by four, branches are ambiguous, the generator is invalid/non-total, or any action/outcome/result/failure length changes cadence or checkpoint assignment.
